role_client_001.name: IT Director
role_client_001.definition: Senior technology executive responsible for overseeing IT strategy, infrastructure planning, and technology implementation decisions within the healthcare organization.

role_client_002.name: Chief Medical Officer
role_client_002.definition: Senior physician executive responsible for clinical operations, quality assurance, and medical staff oversight. Key decision maker for clinical system implementations.

role_client_003.name: Nursing Director
role_client_003.definition: Senior nursing leader responsible for nursing operations, staff management, and clinical workflow optimization. Primary contact for nursing-related system requirements.

role_client_004.name: Practice Manager
role_client_004.definition: Administrative leader responsible for day-to-day operations, staff coordination, and workflow management in clinical practice settings.

role_client_005.name: EHR Administrator
role_client_005.definition: Technical specialist responsible for Electronic Health Record system configuration, user management, and day-to-day system administration tasks.

role_client_006.name: Clinical Workflow Coordinator
role_client_006.definition: Healthcare professional responsible for optimizing clinical processes, coordinating between departments, and ensuring efficient patient care workflows.

role_client_007.name: Quality Assurance Manager
role_client_007.definition: Healthcare administrator responsible for maintaining quality standards, compliance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.

role_client_008.name: Training Coordinator
role_client_008.definition: Education specialist responsible for organizing staff training programs, developing training materials, and coordinating educational initiatives.

role_consultant_001.name: Senior Implementation Consultant
role_consultant_001.definition: Experienced healthcare technology consultant responsible for leading complex system implementations, customer relationship management, and strategic guidance.

role_consultant_002.name: Technical Integration Specialist
role_consultant_002.definition: Technology expert specializing in system integrations, API configurations, and technical troubleshooting for healthcare technology implementations.

role_consultant_003.name: Clinical Workflow Analyst
role_consultant_003.definition: Healthcare consultant with clinical background specializing in workflow analysis, process optimization, and clinical best practices implementation.

role_consultant_004.name: Training Specialist
role_consultant_004.definition: Education consultant responsible for developing and delivering comprehensive training programs for healthcare staff on new systems and processes.

role_consultant_005.name: Data Migration Specialist
role_consultant_005.definition: Technical consultant specializing in healthcare data extraction, transformation, and migration from legacy systems to new platforms.

role_consultant_006.name: Project Manager
role_consultant_006.definition: Experienced project management professional responsible for coordinating implementation timelines, resource allocation, and stakeholder communication.

role_consultant_007.name: Quality Assurance Consultant
role_consultant_007.definition: QA specialist responsible for testing implementations, validating system functionality, and ensuring quality standards are met before go-live.

role_consultant_008.name: Customer Success Manager
role_consultant_008.definition: Relationship management specialist focused on ensuring customer satisfaction, addressing concerns, and identifying opportunities for additional value.

role_consultant_009.name: Support Specialist
role_consultant_009.definition: Technical support consultant responsible for ongoing customer support, troubleshooting issues, and providing system maintenance assistance.

role_consultant_010.name: Business Analyst
role_consultant_010.definition: Analytics consultant specializing in healthcare business processes, requirements gathering, and system optimization recommendations.
